scientific_integrity: All finite certificates replayed with exact integer/rational arithmetic. General result is proved by an infinite argument and an unconditional published analytic estimate; finite tests alone are not treated as a proof.
scientific_limitations: Only Z[i] at reciprocal fourth power; no component probability masses or general quadratic-ring theorem. A prior unindexed result is not ruled out. Uses an explicitly cited prime-progression theorem.
title: Exactly two closure components for the Gaussian reciprocal-fourth-power divisor sum
